nodes.label: nomad-agent (Python FastAPI + LangGraph)
nodes.rationale: Polyglot split chosen to keep Node for auth/CRUD and Python for agentic pipeline — enables model-agnostic LLM switching without touching the Node service. LangGraph selected over ADK because it treats model provider as an injection point, allowing Groq/Anthropic/Gemini/OpenAI swap with one line.

nodes.label: Node-Python HTTP Contract
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget pattern (202 Accepted) chosen so Node returns 201 to client immediately. Internal shared secret used instead of user JWT to authenticate inter-service calls — both services are private, mTLS deferred.

nodes.label: Progress Pacer (fake sequential progression)
nodes.rationale: LangGraph runs 4 research agents in parallel; honest reporting would cause phase numbers to bounce. Fake-sequential (1→5) gives the polished UX the animation design expects, while the discoveries array still fills with real data.

nodes.label: Polling Strategy (no SSE/WebSocket)
nodes.rationale: Polling already implemented and works. SSE through Node + service-role Supabase write would add machinery for a 2-minute animation. Deferred indefinitely.

nodes.label: Python Direct DB Write Strategy
nodes.rationale: Agent writes directly to Supabase using service-role key instead of posting back to Node. Avoids extra network hop, extra schema validation layer, and another source of schema drift. Node still owns JWT auth on the original POST.
